overview:
**Fire danger is Low today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, with wet, cloudy weather keeping conditions calm.**
- Outlook rises briefly to Moderate Friday (Oct. 23) before easing back to Low through Oct. 28.
- Today's rain showers and thunderstorms (70% chance) with light east winds, followed by more showers and storms overnight (80% chance), are adding moisture to fuels.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted in the Uncompahgre, Gunnison, and Tres Rios BLM field offices, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect; Ouray County has also rescinded all fire restrictions for unincorporated areas.
- No new or uncontained large wildfires are reported in or near these Western Colorado counties in the latest national situation report.
